capabilities: Navigate canvas nodes via smooth pan-and-zoom on link click
Resolve node, same-canvas and cross-canvas links
Style link text with color, size, bold, italic and underline
Copy card links from the context menu
Render Markdown and math in link text and suppress hover previews
extras: Cross-canvas navigation and hover-preview suppression are toggleable; styles are written as inline HTML in the link alias so they travel with the file and support Ctrl+Z. README notes verification against Obsidian 1.13.7 plus npm regression and smoke tests.
intentEvidence: Make internal links inside Canvas cards behave like PowerPoint hyperlinks.
problem: Clicking a link inside a Canvas card opens a new tab instead of moving the canvas viewport to the target node, and link text offers no styling.
summary: Canvas plugin that makes internal links in cards act like PowerPoint hyperlinks, smoothly panning and zooming to the target node, with inline link styling.
